difficultyRationale: Tests that abrupt completion of finally by return replaces a pending return from the try block.
explanation: The try block prepares to return 1, but the finally block itself returns 2. Abrupt completion of finally replaces the pending return from try, so the method returns 2.

options.explanation: The pending return from try is discarded when finally returns.
The return from finally determines the method result.
Only one value is returned from the method.

options.text: It does not compile because finally cannot return.
options.explanation: A return in finally is legal, though often discouraged because it replaces prior abrupt completion.

references.title: JLS 14.20.2 Execution of try-finally and try-catch-finally
